name: rnsis-nexus
description: RNSIS Nexus — School Management & Fee Tracking System for RNSIS International School

scripts.build: npm run build -w @rnsis/shared && npm run build -w @rnsis/api && npm run build -w @rnsis/web
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w @rnsis/shared && npm run typecheck -w @rnsis/api && npm run typecheck -w @rnsis/web
scripts.test: npm run test -w @rnsis/shared && npm run test -w @rnsis/api
